targetWords.definition: To argue is to angrily speak to someone because you do not agree.
targetWords.example: ■l/l/e argued about where to go for dinner.

targetWords.definition: To communicate is to give information by talking, writing, etc.
targetWords.example: I communicated with Paul about his new ideas.

targetWords.definition: A crowd is a large group of people.
targetWords.example: A large crowd had gathered on the street to see the accident.

targetWords.definition: To depend on someone or something is to need them.
targetWords.example: •Children depend on their parents for many things.

targetWords.definition: A dish is a plate.
targetWords.example: She put a clean white dish on the table.

targetWords.definition: If something is empty, it does not have anything in it.
targetWords.example: My gas tank was almost empty, so I couldn't drive my car very long.

targetWords.definition: If something is exact, it is just the right amount.
targetWords.example: Please use the exact amount of sugar for the cake.

targetWords.definition: If something is fresh, it is new.
targetWords.example: I just bought these oranges. They are very fresh.

targetWords.definition: To gather is to collect several things usually from different places.
targetWords.example: Sam gathered some flowers for his mother.

targetWords.definition: To indicate means to show, point or make something clear.
targetWords.example: He pointed to his eyes to indicate where he had hurt himself.

targetWords.definition: An item is a thing that you buy or sell.
targetWords.example: 1have many items for school in my bag.

targetWords.definition: To offer is to present someone with something.
targetWords.example: He offered me the keys to his car.

targetWords.definition: The price of something is how much it costs.
targetWords.example: What is the price of this item?

targetWords.definition: A product is something that is made.
targetWords.example: My sister has many beauty products in her room.

targetWords.definition: Property is something that someone owns.
targetWords.example: The house is now my property.

targetWords.definition: To purchase something is to buy it.
targetWords.example: I recently purchased a new car.

targetWords.definition: To recommend something is to say that someone should do it.
targetWords.example: •My doctor recommended that I get some exercise.

targetWords.definition: To select something is to choose it.
targetWords.example: I hope that I selected the right answers on the test.

story.title: The Little Red Chicken
story.passage:
A little red chicken had a store in a small town. She sold many different items

to people in the town. The people loved her products.

One day, a cat came to her property. He saw the sign that indicated where

the chicken's store was located. He wanted to purchase bread, but the chicken's

store was almost empty. She had only a bag of wheat.*

"You can use the wheat to make bread," the chicken said.

" No, I don't want to work," the cat said. " I just want to buy bread." The cat

became angry and left the store.

Later, the little red chicken saw the cat in a crowd.

" I will help you make the bread," she said.

But the cat treated her badly. He did not even communicate with her.

He did not want to do any work.

So the chicken decided to make the bread. She selected the exact amount of

wheat to make fresh bread. She used a stone to pound the wheat to get it ready.

Soon, her bread was ready.

The cat came and saw the bread on a dish.

" Give me some of your bread," he said.

" No," said the little red chicken. "You did not help me make the bread. So

you shall not have any to eat."

The cat argued with the chicken. He tried to offer a price for it.

But the little red chicken did not want to

sell her bread.

" Don't depend on others

to do work for you," said

the little red chicken.

"Then how will I get bread?" the cat asked.

" I recommend doing some work," said the little red

chicken. " Use a tool to plant your own wheat. When it

grows big, you can gather it and make your own bread.

You need to learn to do work for what you want."

*wheat - a type of plant used to make bread
